page.title: Sign-in for named reporters
page.intro: Employees who report under their name sign in with their own company account. Add one connection per place they sign in: a Microsoft Entra directory, a Google Workspace, or work email and password. Each email domain belongs to one connection.
page.anonymousNote: Anonymous reporting never changes: reporters who stay anonymous are never asked to sign in.

empty.title: No sign-in connections yet
empty.body: Employees can only report anonymously until you add a connection.

copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

fields.name: Name
fields.showButton: Show as a button on the portal

provider.microsoft: Employees sign in with their Microsoft work account, through your own Entra app.
provider.google: Employees sign in with their Google Workspace account, through your own OAuth client.
provider.password: Employees sign in with their work email and a password, after confirming the mailbox with an emailed code. No app is needed.

hints.providerFixed: The provider can’t be changed after creation.
hints.name: For your admins, e.g. “Acme Bank – Google”.
hints.entity: The entity these employees belong to, or the whole group.
hints.domains: Every work email domain that signs in here. A domain can belong to only one connection. Personal mailboxes such as gmail.com can’t be used.
hints.tenantId: From the app’s Overview page in Entra: a GUID like 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47.

clientId.microsoft: Application (client) ID, from the app’s Overview page in Entra.

hints.secret: Paste the secret value. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
hints.secretSet: Secret is set — enter a new one to replace it.
hints.showButton: Reporters see a direct button on the portal instead of typing their email. Usually off when you have several entities.

redirect.microsoft: Add this in your Microsoft app, as a Web redirect URI.
redirect.google: Add this in your Google OAuth client, under Authorized redirect URIs.

hints.redirectUnset: The server has no redirect URL set yet, so sign-in can’t finish. Ask Xposer support.

errors.name: Enter a name.
errors.domainsRequired: Add at least one email domain.
errors.domainFormat: “{{domain}}” isn’t a domain. Use the part after @, e.g. acmebank.sa.
errors.domainPublic: “{{domain}}” is a personal mailbox domain. Use your company’s own domain.
errors.tenantId: That doesn’t look like a Directory ID. It is a GUID, e.g. 72f988bf-86f1-41af-91ab-2d7cd011db47.
errors.buttonLabel: Enter the button label, or turn the button off.

toast.added: Connection added. Copy its redirect URL into your app, then Test.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Employees on its domains won’t be able to sign in to report under their name. To stop sign-in for a while, switch the connection off instead.

guide.intro: Give these steps to your IT team. They need the Redirect URL above.
guide.saveFirst: Save the connection first to get its Redirect URL.

microsoft.title: Setup guide: Microsoft Entra
steps: Entra admin center → App registrations → New registration.
Name it, e.g. “Xposer reporting”. Supported account types: Accounts in this organizational directory only.
Redirect URI: platform Web (not SPA), and paste the Redirect URL.
Certificates & secrets → New client secret → copy the Value.
From Overview, copy the Application (client) ID and the Directory (tenant) ID.
API permissions: openid, email and profile (Microsoft Graph, delegated). Grant admin consent if your tenant requires it.
Paste the client ID, secret and tenant ID into this connection, then press Test.

google.title: Setup guide: Google Workspace
steps: Google Cloud console → APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen: User type Internal (only your Workspace).
Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → type Web application.
Authorized redirect URIs: paste the Redirect URL.
Copy the Client ID and Client secret into this connection, then press Test.
